تقتوون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَوُونَ (taqtawūna) /taq.ta.wuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
# تُقْتَوَوْنَ (tuqtawawna) /tuq.ta.waw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
